text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The two of us ended up being put in charge 
of the orientation...! U-Um, will we 
really be able to do this...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Leading the children around and guiding 
them through the academy— it's certainly 
nerve-wracking.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, exactly. ...Still, they're 
probably looking forward to it so much, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Rice wants everyone to have fun—Rice 
wants to make them happy, so I'll do my 
absolute best to guide them!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way. Rice-san, let's 
do a rehearsal tomorrow right away!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-This is the gym! There are workout 
machines fit for whatever area you want to 
train.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is the swimming pool. It is mainly 
used to strengthen cardiopulmonary func— 
...Ah, was that too difficult of a 
word...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tadaaa...! Here's the track...! Rice 
really likes the soft woodchip track, 
because—...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, this feels like just a plain 
facility tour... I don't think they'll 
find it very entertaining...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What can we do to make their dreams 
swell with wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san, the reason you first wanted 
to run was because of books, right...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
With my sword I shall carve the way! Unto 
glory—!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! T-That's it—!! That's it, Rice 
might have figured it out!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A way to make everyone have fun and want 
to run in races too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's about to start! I'm so 
excited!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child B
text_block_list.text:
It's Tracen Academy, so you know it's 
gonna be something super awesome!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: My name is Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my all in training, and 
seize glorious victory—!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child A
text_block_list.text:
Woah—?! S-Something incredible just 
started!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hero Rob Roy-san...! Rice wants to run in 
races and win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to win and bring a smile to 
everyone's face...! Please give... courage 
to Rice too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Child B
text_block_list.text: Hero Rob Roy—! Please help her out—!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let us forge ahead together toward 
victory! This marks the beginning of each 
of our heroic tales!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Now, onto the path of victory!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, courage is welling up inside me...! 
Thank you, Hero Rob Roy-san!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That was a massive success! Everyone 
became interested in races, and above all, 
they seemed to have so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but... that wasn't the only reason. 
Rice wanted Rob Roy-san to have fun and 
feel happy too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san, remember when you were 
imitating a hero in the room before? You 
looked so incredibly cool...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Rice-san...!

I saw Rice Shower and Zenno Rob Roy 
chatting happily with each other.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, you were watching 
us...!
choice_data_list:
Everyone looked like they were having a 
great time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Really? I hope so!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It was so well received, it might be great 
to do it again sometime.
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'd love to see your play again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I wonder what kind of play we 
should do next time?
